title: feat(email): force From display name + append careers@ signature in DWD backend
body:
## Summary - **Fix #1 — From header**: Import `email.utils.formataddr`; force `From` to `Call Center Doctors Careers ` using `formataddr((GMAIL_FROM_DISPLAY_NAME, self._impersonate))`. Gmail API previously collapsed bare addresses from `msg.from_email`. Env var `GMAIL_FROM_DISPLAY_NAME` overrides the display name (default: `Call Center Doctors Careers`). - **Fix #2 — Signature**: Add `gmail.settings.basic` to `_SCOPES`. On `__init__`, call `users.settings.sendAs.list(userId='me')` impersonating careers@, find the primary `sendAs` entry, store `.signature` HTML in `self._signature_html`. On any error, logs a warning and falls back to empty string (non-fatal). In `_build_mime`, append `

{signature}` to the HTML body before MIME assembly. Plain-text-only sends are unaffected. ## Files changed - `horilla/gmail_dwd_backend.py` — 42 insertions, 5 deletions (lines 1–148) ## Test plan - [ ] Restart `horilla-server` container; check logs for signature fetch success or warning - [ ] Send test email via Django shell `EmailMultiAlternatives` to `jason@ccdocs.com` with subject `[HORILLA-SIG-TEST]` - [ ] Verify in Gmail: From header = `Call Center Doctors Careers ` - [ ] Verify HTML body ends with the careers@ Gmail signature block - [ ] Confirm plain-text-only system emails still send without error 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
